metadata.description: A pixel creature that lives above your Claude Code prompt and watches what Claude Code doesn't show you.

plugins.name: pixlings
plugins.description: A tiny pixel creature that lives above your Claude Code prompt. It counts down your prompt cache and guards it on model switches, wakes Claude when your usage limit resets, brings a helper for every subagent, makes sound on Windows and Linux, yelps before risky commands, rolls its eyes at "You're absolutely right", and brings back your old /buddy.
